author: Erynor
body:
IGN: Erynor
Reason: Forcefield
Why I should be unbanned: I wasn't hacking. I'm 11 and idk how to install mods of any kinda, not even optifine. I had to get a friend to install optifine for me. even then, that was back in 1.6.4, so I can't use that version on servers these days

Thanks for your time.
-Erynor
